title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
abstract: arXiv:2611.26359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values. A coordinate's own corrupted state can make prediction easy, potentially reducing the pressure to learn dependencies between coordinates. We study leave-one-out (LOO) prediction, in which each coordinate is predicted from the corrupted states of the other coordinates. We show that, under stated assumptions, jump diffusions with complete coordinate resets and state-independent clocks preserve the prescribed marginals when reset destinations use exact LOO probabilities and the drift uses the full endpoint posterior. We further show that this drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities by analytic likelihood completion without additional network evaluations. We evaluate unrestricted, LOO, and completed predictions on Text8 and LM1B text

translated_title: 从上下文中学习：跳跃扩散过程中的留一预测
translated_abstract: 连续扩散模型通过嵌入空间中的随机动力学生成离散数据。我们考虑了一类跳跃扩散过程，它还会将坐标重置为类别值的嵌入表示。坐标自身被破坏的状态可能使预测变得容易，这可能减弱模型学习坐标间依赖关系的动力。我们研究了留一预测，其中每个坐标仅由其他坐标的被破坏状态来进行预测。我们证明，在给定假设下，具有完全坐标重置和状态无关时钟的跳跃扩散过程，当重置目标使用精确的留一概率且漂移使用完整的端点后验时，能够保持规定的边缘分布。我们进一步证明，该漂移可以通过解析似然补全从留一概率构造出来，而无需额外的网络评估。我们在Text8和LM1B文本数据集上评估了无约束预测、留一预测和补全预测。
tldr: 该论文提出在跳跃扩散模型中采用留一（LOO）预测——每个坐标仅依据其他坐标的破坏状态进行预测——并证明通过解析似然补全可从留一概率构造漂移项，在保持规定边缘分布的同时无需额外网络评估，从而促使模型真正学习坐标间的依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leave-one-out (LOO) prediction in jump diffusions—predicting each coordinate solely from the corrupted states of other coordinates—and proves the drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities via analytic likelihood completion, preserving prescribed marginals without additional network evaluations, thereby forcing the model to genuinely learn inter-coordinate dependencies.
